questions.title: Design a Notification System
questions.question: Which design pattern would you use to build a notification system that sends alerts via email, SMS, and push notifications? Explain your choice.
searchIntent: design pattern for notification system Java
questions.realWorldScenario: Classic scenario question — both Strategy (multiple channel algorithms) and Observer (reacting to events) are valid answers.

searchIntent: which design pattern for caching Java
add cache without modifying code design pattern

questions.title: Payment Processing System

searchIntent: design pattern payment processing system Java
questions.realWorldScenario: Combining Strategy (different algorithms) and OCP (open for extension, closed for modification).
